question: The greatest common factor (HCF) and least common multiple (LCM) of two numbers are 5 and 495 respectively. If one of these numbers is 55, find the other number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM

55 × Second Number = 5 × 495

Second Number = (5 × 495) ÷ 55

Second Number = 495 ÷ 11 = 45

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**
